correctness.rationale: Complete classification of signed transitive C2^2-orbits by stabilizer/sign character yields orbit-type weights 1,2,4 and Burnside cycle products; nonfaithful maps are exactly involution-element classes with positive signed two-cycles. The pole analysis proves the asymptotic, and direct signed permutation enumeration in n<=4 independently matches both formulas.

originality.rationale: The exact all-rank-two subgroup conjugacy and embedded-copy enumerators and quasipolynomial were not implied by the inspected 2022 Coxeter maximal-order abelian subgroup theorem, 2022 wreath-product element-conjugacy results, or 2024 wreath transitivity results. Targeted simultaneous-involution and signed-set searches recovered no statement covering these formulas; common Burnside and induced-character tools are not presented as new. An equivalent earlier formulation is a residual risk.
residual_risks: Possible equivalent result in general wreath-product subgroup conjugacy literature phrased as character-labeled transitive sets or rank-two elementary abelian embedding classification.
Not every historical subgroup paper or inaccessible appendix was read; the arXiv:2305.17426 comparison was abstract-level only.
The novelty is the exact specialized census and asymptotic, not the underlying standard induction, Burnside or Möbius tools.
